changelog:
1.8.0 - Phantom & Summoner
  NEW: PHANTOM boss — cycles between tangible and intangible phases, passing through everything and immune to damage while intangible, with a phase-shift flash and sound
  NEW: SUMMONER boss — spawns up to 5 chasing minion snakes that attack the player; all minions die with the boss and drop a score trail to collect
  FIXED: Minions can now be defeated individually — striking one with your head kills it
  FIXED: Minion AI no longer reverses 180 degrees; they keep moving forward and turn instead of flipping into their own body
  FIXED: Boss now spawns when the target score is reached (single-player regression from the multiplayer world-authority refactor)
  FIXED: Multiplayer client's own snake no longer freezes from a transient host alive flag
  FIXED: Multiplayer client falls back to the game-over panel if the host's game-over message is delayed or lost
  FIXED: Dev boss selector now cycles PHANTOM and SUMMONER without crashing
  MULTIPLAYER: Host + client run the identical simulation; world objects stay host-authoritative while each side owns its snake (peer prediction)
